rule.perBin: the candidate with the smallest standard deviation of ln(orbit-mean observed / orbit-mean model) of D5a (global structure) over the validation window's held-out satellites (GRACE-FO 1, Swarm B, Swarm C)
rule.decayHours: with that perBin and the global structure, the candidate with the smallest pooled standard deviation of ln(observed / D5f) at leads 0-3 days (definitive drivers) over the validation issue days in validationIssueDays
rule.structure: with that perBin and decayHours, the structure with the smallest median 3-day 3D error of D5 (definitive arm) over the validation arcs (validationIssueDays, every target), both structures on the arcs where both have a 3-day error
rule.ties: global structure, smaller perBin, shorter decayHours
